newsitem.title: USA: TVA Sequoyah 2 Tenn. nuclear power unit startup.
newsitem.headline: TVA Sequoyah 2 Tenn. nuclear power unit startup.

text.p: TVA Nuclear's 1,148 megawatt Sequoyah nuclear power unit 2 has begun startup, returning from a scheduled refueling and maintenance outage which began Oct 11, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said.
The unit, in Soddy-Daisy, Tenn., was operating at one percent of capacity as of early Monday morning and was in "mode 2 - startup," the NRC said in its daily plant status report.
The adjacent 1,148 megawatt Sequoyah unit 1 was operating normally at 100 percent of capacity, the NRC said in the report.
TVA Nuclear is a unit of the Tennesee Valley Authority.
-- Chris Reese, New York Power Desk 212-859-1627
